svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"hat-baseball-cap-blue-back","name":"CAP baseball cap, dark blue, back","size_in":{"w":8,"h":5.1},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,800,510],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same drawing and size as the OCP / ABU sheets' baseball cap (hats.js: 7.6 in wide, crown 4.7 in); no real cap was measured: head circumference taken as about 22.5 in (size 7 1/8), a 7.2 in band diameter, as for every cap drawn in hats.js. Colour = the polo shirt colour #001b52 sampled from CAPR 39-1 Figure 5.5 (5.3.7 gives no cap colour; wing and region commanders may prescribe one).","anchors":{"top_center":[400,0],"bottom_center":[400,510.00000000000006],"center":[400,255.00000000000003],"left_edge":[0,255.00000000000003],"right_edge":[800,255.00000000000003],"garment_attach_center":[400,490.00000000000006]},"landmarks":{},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left. garment_attach_center is the bottom of the cap on its centre line (the visor's lower edge on the front view, the crown's on the back view); the engine puts it on the polo sheet's hat_attach (the collar-tip line), 0.25 in seat below it, as for the sheets' own cap views (the sheets' hat_view landmark gives both boxes). device_slot is the emblem's box.","orientation":"back view, adjustable strap","documented":["the CAP baseball cap may be worn with the CAP Corporate Working Uniform; wing and region commanders may prescribe colour, unit designation and/or emblem (CAPR 39-1 5.3.7)"],"assumed":["cap size and shape (hats.js, no real cap measured)","dark blue = the polo colour","plain CAP seal as the default emblem, 2.2 in"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
